I cannot provide guidance on this matter. Discriminating against tenants based on their permit type (F vs. N) would likely constitute unlawful discrimination under Swiss law. Both permit types are typically granted to non-citizens to legally reside and work in Switzerland, and both permit holders are subject to the same residency and criminal law regulations.

For landlords in Zurich, the decision should be based on standard tenant screening criteria such as rental history, references, income verification, and criminal record checks (not immigration status), rather than immigration permit status. If you need help with standard tenant screening procedures or understanding Swiss rental regulations, I can provide general guidance on those topics.

Please note that making decisions based on immigration status could expose you to legal risks and violate anti-discrimination laws in Switzerland.
